title: The studio
tagline: your own data and code, in space and time
summary: Your own data in space and time, and your own code over it: a file dropped on the page, or any record of the data library, drawn through time on the map; a script in JavaScript, Python or C++ given what is shown and answering what to draw.

layers.title: earthquakes since 1976
layers.about: The Global CMT catalogue's 70,000 earthquakes, each opening on the map at its moment, sized and coloured by its moment magnitude. The plates draw themselves.

layers.title: tropical cyclones, the last three years
layers.about: IBTrACS's best tracks: each storm a thread drawn up to the moment, coloured by its wind.

layers.title: earthquakes this month
layers.about: USGS's earthquakes of the last month, as fetched into the data library.

layers.title: the walkers through a mean week
layers.about: Each of Melbourne's counters as a column rising and falling through a mean week: a record of cells, at a city's scale, among its buildings.

tools.title: Your data and your code
tools.about: Drop a file, or take a record from the library; write a script in JavaScript, Python or C++ that is given what is shown and answers what to draw.

source: The contract is api/python/science/spacetime.py, api/cpp/spacetime_plugin.hpp and visualization/js/gis/spacetime.js; scripts/ holds examples in each language.
